title: Execution Roadmap
summary: A five-year phased execution sequence designed to transition Northstar Retail Group from legacy stability to an innovation-led operating model.
narrative: The roadmap is structured to prioritize foundational stability and observability before scaling modernization. Year 1 focuses on stabilizing customer identity, pricing, and returns—critical dependencies for the subsequent order and supply-chain rewrites. This sequencing ensures that the high-risk modernization waves in Years 2 and 3 are built upon a resilient, observable foundation.

Value realization follows a non-linear ramp, where initial investments in platform engineering and delivery-mix shifts are required to unlock higher-order business value. The transition to a 55% offshore delivery mix by Year 3 is a primary lever for reducing run-cost and creating the capacity needed for continuous modernization.

Execution is governed by strict operational constraints, including the mid-November to early January holiday code freeze for customer-facing platforms. The roadmap explicitly accounts for these windows to avoid peak-demand collisions across shared platform teams, ensuring that delivery velocity is maintained without compromising retail peak-season stability.

timeline.milestone: Stabilize identity, pricing, observability, and operating governance.
Launch modernization factory waves and expand shared engineering platform services.
Scale cloud migration, delivery-mix transition, and event-driven operating flows.
Consolidate legacy estates and industrialize ongoing optimization.
Lock in innovation-budget shift and mature the steady-state operating model.

callouts: Wave sequencing is constrained by the annual holiday code freeze, requiring precise alignment of release windows.
Value realization accelerates only after foundational identity and observability work is complete, creating a dependency-aware roadmap.
